mainText: Good morning. Markets open today. Futures point to a rebound after Friday's AI-led selloff. The S and P 500 is up half a percent, the Nasdaq 100 up about one percent, and the Dow is roughly flat. Lower oil prices are helping, with President Trump waiving some sanctions on Russia, along with easing bond yields, ahead of a big tech earnings week featuring Meta, Tesla, Netflix, and SpaceX. In premarket movers, Intel is up nearly four percent after a JPMorgan upgrade to neutral. The S O X L semiconductor ETF is up seven and a half percent on the AI rebound. Broadcom, Nvidia, and CoreWeave are all bouncing about one to two percent. Moderna is down two and a half percent with no fresh news reported. The ten-year Treasury yield is about five point zero eight percent, roughly flat versus Friday, near four-week lows and well below the peak of about five point three one percent two weeks ago.
